sections.label: Joseph Schooling wins Olympic gold
sections.summary: Joseph Schooling won Singapore's first Olympic Gold in the Men's 100-metre Butterfly, beating Michael Phelps, Chad le Clos and Laszlo Cseh and breaking Phelps' Olympic Record.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Almost halfway around the globe, at the Olympic Aquatics Stadium in Rio, 21-year-old Joseph Schooling powered his way to Singapore's first-ever Olympic Gold medal in the Men's 100-metre Butterfly Swimming event.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: He did so in style, besting former Olympic champions Michael Phelps, Chad le Clos and Laszlo Cseh.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: He even broke the Olympic Record, set eight years ago by Phelps.

sections.label: spexScholarship support for Joseph
sections.summary: As a spexScholarship recipient from Sport Singapore, Joseph trained full-time with support including sports medicine and sports science services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: As a recipient of the spexScholarship offered by Sport Singapore, Joseph was able to train full-time with a holistic system of support, including access to advanced sports medicine and sports science services.

sections.label: Historic gold and Singapore spirit
sections.summary: The passage states this first Olympic Gold came after SG50 and represents a historic achievement exemplifying the Singapore spirit, with Joseph quoted on small countries doing extraordinary things.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: He said, "Regardless of what sports we do, he's an inspiration to all of us.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: So long as you have the passion for it, put in the hard work, we are able to achieve something really great." This is the first Olympic Gold for Singapore and it comes just after our SG50 celebrations last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: As we embark on a new chapter of nation-building for the next 50 years, this represents an important first step in this first year in the journey of our next 50 years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: It is a historic achievement that exemplifies the Singapore spirit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: To quote Joseph, "This record shows that even people from the smallest countries in the world can do extraordinary things." Joseph and all our sporting heros have inspired us with their achievements.

sections.label: Open top bus victory parade
sections.summary: Sport Singapore is planning an open top bus victory parade on the streets to celebrate Joseph's achievement.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Not everyone could make it to the airport this morning.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: So, I am delighted that Sport Singapore is planning an open top bus victory parade out on the streets to celebrate Joseph's achievement.

sections.label: Support for athletes and Paralympics
sections.summary: The passage states spexScholarships and Race to Rio helped Joseph and other Olympians, and that MCCY and Sport Singapore will keep supporting young athletes, with 12 athletes sent to the Paralympics.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: On Saturday, he went one step further, beating Phelps to the Olympic Gold medal.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: I am glad that our spexScholarships and Race to Rio programme has helped Joseph and the rest of our Olympians fly our flag high on a stage like this.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY), together with Sport Singapore, will continue to support many more young athletes, who have no doubt been inspired by Joseph, to similarly excel and fulfil their sporting aspirations.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: This year, we are sending our largest-ever contingent to the Paralympics: 12 athletes across six sports, and almost half of them are debutants.

sections.label: Olympic gold and record
sections.summary: The passage states an Olympic gold and an Olympic record, calling it marvellous.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: An Olympic gold, an Olympic record – how marvellous!

sections.label: Schooling parents on Olympic win
sections.summary: Joseph Schooling's parents stayed grounded after his Olympic swimming gold, with his father calling him an ambassador giving Singapore's children hope.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Despite their son making history by becoming the first Southeast Asian to ever win an Olympic swimming gold, Joseph's parents did not gloat in his victory, but were fully grounded in what his victory meant.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I was personally disarmed by the reaction of his father, Mr Colin Schooling, who said, and I quote: "The most important thing is to be an ambassador for all our children in Singapore that gives them hope that they also can do it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: There's nothing special about him, just a boy who is interested in the sport." Indeed, sport has always had magical powers to inspire generations and galvanise nations.

sections.label: Salute regardless of win or lose
sections.summary: The passage states that whether you win or lose, you are saluted, and that this inspires people to believe the sky is the limit.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Whether you win or lose, we salute you.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: It serves to inspire all of us that no matter our personal circumstances, as long as we put our minds to the task, the sky is the limit.
